items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know that one of my block gang who was a lady name of Carmen McRae and she was gettin' around pretty good with some of the … she was friends with Billie Holiday and so forth. And we wrote a song called “Dream of Life”, the two of us, which Billie Holiday recorded for us back there in those high sc

ctx.x: Uh, she … you're right that she did go to Hunter College. She got her Bachelor's from Hunter College but she got her Master's Degree from Columbia University. That's where it was. Thank you, Billie.
